script.cover_1: A meeting is called tonight for tomorrow. Which text respects the evening?
script.payoff: The better text gives a late start, a length and an agenda.
script.caption: A meeting without an agenda is a surprise with a calendar invite. Send this to the one who always calls them.
script.request: A meeting is wanted tomorrow morning, announced tonight.
script.pushy: Meeting tomorrow 8 am. Everyone must join, no excuses.
script.professional: Can we meet 11 am tomorrow, half an hour? Agenda is attached.
script.why: It gives a time with some room, a length and an agenda.
script.reply_me: I will join at 8 am. Could you send the agenda tonight so I come prepared?
